ds.t: "We must build a mandir in Delhi"
w: Chandrakantbhai Trivedi, a satsangi devotee, was a senior officer of Dena Bank in Delhi. A letter had come from him. The letter mentioned obtaining land in Delhi. He had written, "Land for the mandir is about to be obtained." Hearing this news, Yogiji Maharaj was very pleased.

With it was a plan of the mandir, and everything about building the mandir immediately was written in it. That day, while eating, Swamishri said, "If Nirgun Swami were here, he would have been very pleased. He had great enthusiasm for building mandirs. We fell ill, otherwise we would beat the drum across the whole country." Yogiji Maharaj repeatedly made the resolve to build a grand mandir in Delhi. Let us recall some of those resolves here...

On another day, while eating, Yogiji Maharaj brought up Delhi: "It would be good if a shikharbaddh mandir were built there... If the Yamuna wants seva, it will happen... Delhi is called the flag of the eighty-four ports. If a mandir is built there, it will look very fine."

On 20 November 1969, after his morning puja, speaking about Delhi he said, "We definitely have to build a mandir in Delhi. We want to install the murti of Shastriji Maharaj. It is certainly our wish, and then it is up to everyone..."
"Bapa, if you wish it, it will surely happen," said Ishwarcharan Swami.

"There is the fear of others... It is nothing from us, but since Daulatrambhai said so..." Swamishri spoke, citing another as witness. (When Daulatrambhai Krupashankar, a senior satsangi and scholar of Nadiad, understood that the Akshar Purushottam upasana is in line with the scriptures and with the principles of Shriji Maharaj, he had said that in the future people would install a golden murti of Shastriji Maharaj and perform his arti.)

On 23 November 1969, Yogiji Maharaj was doing darshan before the murti of Ghanshyam Maharaj. As he turned back from there, he said, "Let me do darshan, my good man. After this I will not get to come again for now."
"Is Ghanshyam Maharaj saying anything?" asked Ishwarcharan Swami.
"Quickly build a mandir in Delhi and install the murti of Shastriji Maharaj..." Residing in Swamishri, Ghanshyam Maharaj spoke as if in person.
Gondal, 13 November 1969

Chandrakantbhai Trivedi was a senior officer of Dena Bank in Delhi. Today a letter came from him: "Land for the mandir is about to be obtained." Hearing this, Yogiji Maharaj was very pleased. With it was a plan of the mandir, and everything about building the mandir immediately was written in it. While eating, Swamishri said, "If Nirgun Swami were here, he would have been very pleased. He had great enthusiasm for building mandirs. We fell ill, otherwise we would beat the drum across the whole country..."

Today too, while eating, he brought up Delhi: "It would be good if a shikharbaddh mandir (a traditional stone mandir with spires) were built... If the Yamuna wants seva, it will happen... Delhi is called the flag of the eighty-four ports. If a mandir is built there, it will look very fine."

(20 November 1969) Today, while drinking his herbal decoction, he spoke about Delhi: "We definitely have to build a mandir in Delhi. We want to install Shastriji Maharaj. It is certainly our wish, and then it is up to everyone..."
"Bapa! If you wish it, it will surely happen," I said.

"It is nothing from us, but since Daulatrambhai said so..." Swamishri spoke, citing another as witness. (When Daulatrambhai Krupashankar, a senior satsangi and scholar of Nadiad, understood that the Akshar Purushottam upasana is in line with the scriptures and with the principles of Shriji Maharaj, he had said that in the future people would install a golden murti of Shastriji Maharaj and perform his arti.)

(23 November 1969) Today was Punam (full moon day), so he had come specially. He was doing darshan before Ghanshyam Maharaj. As he turned back, he said, "Let me do darshan, my good man. I will not get to come again for now."
"Is Ghanshyam Maharaj saying anything?" I asked.
"Quickly build a mandir in Delhi and install Shastriji Maharaj..." Residing in Swamishri, Ghanshyam Maharaj himself spoke.
Sadhu Ishwarcharandas

A 2-day program for ex-students of BAPS Gurukul commenced from today. The evening assembly program included, experiences by ex-students, a kawali, folk dance and a drama about the Gurukul as a school of character-building. Outstanding students were then honored for attaining excellent results. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly of students.

In the morning, during Swamishri's puja, devotees of the Sabarkantha district participated in a special mahapuja ceremony offering their devotion to Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and guruhari Pramukh Swami Maharaj. After his puja, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha ceremony for the murtis to be installed in four new Sanskardhams in the suburbs of Amdavad - Sola Road, Saraspur, Bopal and Ghatlodia-Naranpura.
In the afternoon, a special Women's assembly was held which was conducted entirely by the Women's Wing.

The evening assembly was celebrated as the Pushpa Tula Ceremony. It featured cultural presentation by chuldren, teenagers and youths, speeches by senior sadhus and a special ceremony in which Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was honored. At the conclusion of the celebration, Swamishri blessed the assembly, "Those who have recognized God and realized the glory of God are not taken in by other things. They only do what will please God. To please God, (worldly) things are an obstacle. And to leave them is very difficult. But for a true devotee of God, there is nothing greater than God in this world ..."
At 11.30 a.m. Swamishri arrived in Ajmer. Swamishri addressed a small satsang assembly in Hindi.
At 5.15 p.m. Swamishri departed from Ajmer and arrived in Jaipur at 7.30 p.m. Swamishri was welcomed by the devotees of Jaipur and he blessed the satsang assembly.
After Thakorji’s darshan, Swamishri left the mandir at 7.35 pm and arrived at Heathrow airport at 8.20 pm. The Air India flight took off at 10.25 pm towards India.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
3 November 2006, London
Chandrahasbhai (Dallas) observed an 85-hour waterless fast
5 November 2006, London
Devotees pilgrimaged by foot from the former mandir in Islington to Neasden. Eleven-year-old Sharad Patel pilgrimaged from west London to the mandir.
17 November 2006, London
Teenagers Arpan K. Patel, Jay C. Patel, Dipesh D. Patel, Hitesh D. Patel, Ketan R. Patel, Rupesh R. Patel, Ramesh Depala, Hitesh Mehta and Nilkanth Patel performed a fast for 86 hours.

st.t: Pramukh Swami Maharaj – Departure Day – Friday 17 November 2006 London
w: After a month of extraordinary weather, on Friday 17th November 2006, even the heavens became tearful at the departure of Pramukh Swami Maharaj from London Mandir. It was his 18th visit to London – one of the most memorable and definitely the most impromptu of them all. Truly the last 30 days had echoed ' Kon jãne ã kem thayu, ãvyu anachintavyu sukh...’. The evening before on Thursday 16th November, a short assembly was held in which Swamishri highlighted the importance of nirdoshbuddhi in God and the Satpurush. He also praised the volunteers of UK Satsang Mandal for their hospitality in catering for devotees who had come from all over the world for darshan and samagam. On Friday, Swamishri performed darshan in the main shrines and also performed dandvats at the central shrine. After abhishek of Shri Nilkanth Varni, Swamishri gave darshan in the Haveli packed with devotees. Swamishri then gave his own special farewell by walking down the centre of the Haveli, blessing everyone with his darshan. He left as he had come 30 days ago – with folded hands and unprecedented love radiating from his eyes.
Seven devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Jaliya.

Prior to his morning puja Swamishri came for Thakorji’s darshan in the mandir. A grand annakut of fresh vegetables, fruits and nuts were arranged in all three shrines. Swamishri showered his blessings upon the sadhus and devotees for the devotional offerings to the deities. On arriving in the assembly hall for his morning puja, an impressive vegetable market had been set on stage. Swamishri blessed the assembly, praising their devotion and love for satsang. Swamishri also emphasized upon the doership of God. Finally, Swamishri picked up different vegetables in turn and showed them to the assembly. The devotees were in raptures at Swamishri’s divine darshan.
Today, as it was Bhakti Day, there was a question and answer session on devotion with Mahant Swami Maharaj:
Question: "The members of my family have faith in someone else, so they do not like it when I do satsang and apply the tilak chandlo. What should I do?"
Swamishri said, "If you want to please Swamibapa, do it, and if you want to please your family, don't." Swamishri kept giving precise and sharp answers in one or two sentences each.
Question: "How can devotion with a sense of innocence towards all come?"

Swamishri said, "When they print notes, it was ordinary paper, but they put a stamp on it and it became a 2,000 rupee note. So this is Maharaj's stamp, that everyone is divine. So consider everyone innocent."
Question: "Wouldn't it do if we don't wear the mala, apply tilak chandlo and so on outwardly? Because the fruit of doing it outwardly and inwardly is the same."
Swamishri said, "If we think in our mind that we have ten million rupees, will they come?"
Everyone burst out laughing. The answer had been given.
Question: "Give us a remedy so that the mighty maya does not trouble us."

Swamishri said, "All this is a matter of faith. Satsang is true. In worldly life, even what is false is believed to be true, and this is true and still the mind does not take to it. Our mind sticks to what is seen as ready cash. And this is not seen, but it is a matter of billions of rupees."
Question: "Women seem to have more devotion than men. What is the reason?"
Swamishri laughed and said, "Ask them."
Everyone burst out laughing.
Then Swamishri said, "We have had the company of Swamibapa (Pramukh Swami Maharaj) from close by, so we do not understand his glory. They are at a distance, so they understand it."
Today's question and answer session too was joyful and wonderful.

Today, speaking of Dr Anil Sanganeria, who had come to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj, Amrutvadandas Swami said that he is a well known oncologist (cancer doctor) working with famous hospitals here such as Bombay Hospital, Breach Candy Hospital and Cumballa Hill Hospital. He is also a very good artist. After meeting Swamishri, giving his opinion, he said:

"Guruji is a great symbol of humility, humanity, simplicity, silence and solitude. Being with him even for few moments felt like meditation. Extremely peaceful, soothing. As if he silently transmits salvation in all of us, all around.
Really,
A Grand, Gracious, Godly Guruji."

(Guruji, Mahant Swami Maharaj, is a great symbol of humility, humanity, simplicity, silence and solitude. Even a few moments spent with him bring a state like samadhi. He is utterly peaceful and soothing. It is as if he quietly spreads liberation in us and in the whole of creation. Guruji is truly grand, gracious and a form of God.)
After meeting Swamishri he also said, "What a face Swami has! Very vibrant."
Then Amrutvadandas Swami asked, "Swami! Radiance shines on your face. What is the reason for that?"
"God is within." Swamishri said spontaneously.
Then Amrutvadandas Swami asked another question: "Swami! When did you feel that God had entered you in a special way?"
Swamishri said emphatically, "Maharaj is there."
These three words prove Swamishri's eternal perfection.
Today Sandeepbhai, a solicitor, finished a meeting with Mahant Swami Maharaj and, overwhelmed, exclaimed, "This is the same Bapa (Pramukh Swami Maharaj). There is not the slightest difference."

When the sadhus asked the reason, he explained, "There were certain matters that I had told only to Bapa (Pramukh Swami Maharaj). But when I spoke to Swamishri and saw the way he responded, I felt that he is the very same. Swamishri started right from where we had finished."
This is one more among the experiences engraved in hundreds of thousands of hearts.
Giving his blessings in the evening assembly, Mahant Swami Maharaj said:

"How many protocols does the president of a country face in reaching any place? Then how many would Maharaj face? But Maharaj arranged things so that hundreds of thousands and millions of people could come into contact with Him.
Maharaj, by His will, came through the Sant and arranged things so that there would be as many contacts as possible.
The second thing: He has remained manifest through the Sant, and because of that our line remains continuously connected.

Yogibapa used to say, 'The Satpurush is manifest now and will remain so in the future too.' Gunatitanand Swami said, 'He will certainly remain for ten or twenty generations.' And Shastriji Maharaj said, 'The Satpurush never leaves the earth.' So we have safety. Security for liberation, for moksha! Since we have become disciples of Maharaj and Swami, our moksha is guaranteed."
Today Shri Rajesh Lange, chief of the Western Command of the National Security Guard (NSG), had come to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj.
When Vishal, a satsangi youth, told him about coming for Swamishri's darshan, he said, "I will come for darshan, but I don't believe in God."
Then Vishal said, "That's fine, no worries. Sadhus are like friends. Come in that way."
With this background, today Rajeshji arrived for Swamishri's darshan. When he came before Swamishri, Swamishri casually asked him, "What have you hurt on this leg?"
Hearing this, he was astonished. He had a very ordinary small injury on his leg. Coming out, he said, "Even my family would not know this, and Swamiji caught it immediately. Such a guru!"
"The Sant is the relative of all, know this for sure, O soul..." At the very first meeting Rajeshji experienced that our true relative is the Satpurush alone.

Today, after giving the benefit of the Pushpadolotsav in the assembly, as he was leaving, Mahant Swami Maharaj saw the security volunteers on the way and asked the sadhus, "Did these people come to the Phuldol?"
The sadhus said "No". In the lift the sadhus were standing with flower petals. Sanctifying them, Swamishri said, "Shower these on the heads of the security volunteers."
Abhayswarupdas Swami said, "Yes Swami! I will go myself." He took his leave.
History tells us that on those who forgo the benefit of darshan and keep their focus on the command, the pleasure of the Satpurush showers of its own accord.
